answer: Attach four pins to the strip with the help of wax such that they are arranged at nearly equal distances (about 2 cm apart), as shown in Fig. Secure the strip to a stand and label the pins as I, II, III, and IV, as shown in Fig. (If a stand is not available, place the strip between two bricks for support.)
